metadata.scenario: An individual inquires about the company's pet grooming services for large dog breeds. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Betty Lou Smith. I was wondering about your pet grooming services for large dog breeds. Uh, I’m sorry, but we actually don’t offer pet grooming services here at CareFirst Home Health. Oh, I see. I thought maybe you provided that too since you offer various home services. I understand the confusion, Betty. We specialize in home healthcare services like personal care and rehabilitation. Got it! I’ve been using your services for my fall prevention, and I just assumed more services were available. Yes, we do provide a range of skilled nursing and personal care services. Would you like details on any specific services? Actually, yes! I might need some more personal care assistance sessions. Of course! Our personal care assistance is available at $28 to $35 per hour. How many hours are you considering? I think I need around three hours a week, just for some extra help around the house. That sounds good. I can arrange for a caregiver to assist you. Would you prefer the same caregiver each time? Yes, consistency is important for me, especially after my falls. Absolutely, I will make a note to assign the same caregiver based on your past preferences. Thank you! I really appreciate that. What’s the next step? I’ll set up a care plan and reach out to you to confirm the schedule. Can I get your best contact number? Sure, it’s the same number, +13165558135. Great! I’ll also check if there are any available discounts on those sessions for you. That would be wonderful! Thank you so much for your help, Margaret. You're welcome, Betty. I’ll follow up with you later today with the details. I appreciate it! Have a great day! You too! Take care!
